title: cross-functional roadmap sync prep - Jun 2026 (Olivia)
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML)
Date: 2026-06-14 weekly sync (prep notes)
Attendees (planned): Olivia (prod), Raj (eng-serving-runtime), Maya (applied-ml), Dylan (infra), Asha (console), optional: Platform SRE rep
Goals:
- Align on top priorities for Q3 roadmap slices that touch inference economics (latency/cost/reliability)
- Surface cross-team dependencies and major blockers (kernel work, dedicated infra, rollout tooling)
- Agree on evaluation gates for model upgrades and quantization rollouts
- Quick decision on whether to put KV-cache auto-rollout on roadmap for July pilot

Background/context (short):
- Product wants 20% reduction in per-token cost for hosted API without increasing p95 latency beyond 10% from baseline. Suggested levers: batching improvements, smarter routing to cheaper variants, wider quantization profiles.
- Applied ML team has a prototype quantized 4-bit runtime that shows 25% CPU/GPU perf improvement but has some regression on long-context coherence (seen on internal evals).
- Serving runtime planned kernel refactor (ENG-4820) targeted for late July which may block certain quantized kernels until merged.

Agenda (30-40m):
1) Quick round: priorities & top risk (5m)
2) Applied ML: quantization prototype status + eval summary (7-8m)
3) Serving-runtime: kernel refactor timeline + compatibility impacts (7-8m)
4) Product: rollout gating criteria and metrics we need (5m)
5) Decide on pilot for KV-cache auto-rollout + owner (5m)
6) Action items & next sync (3-4m)

Key questions (to raise):
- From applied-ml: what subset of customers/benchmarks show the coherence regressions? (Maya)
- From runtime: can we support multi-variant routing (quantized fallback) by mid-July or is that post-kernel-refactor? (Raj)
- From product: what is the acceptable delta on p95 for cost-saving rollouts? Need exact threshold to gate (Olivia)

Notes / talking points (draft):
- Maya: internal evals show regressions concentrated on long-form summarization (>2k tokens) and some multi-turn instruction-following. Short-context generation (<512 tokens) is fine. Need more A/B evals on customer prompts (ask SRE for sampling).
- Raj: kernel refactor is high risk for new quantized kernels. Timeline: branch cut 2026-07-20, merge window 07-20 -> 08-10. If we want quantized kernels in prod earlier, we need a separate compatibility branch + backports (costly).
- Dylan: infra capacity for dedicated quantized variant is available but autoscaling policy needs tweak to avoid double-scheduling currently observed in the prototype.
- Product: propose gating metrics: token-cost reduction >=15% AND p95 increase <=8% AND quality-regression delta on eval suite A/B < 1% Rouge/semantic metric. If applied-ml can't meet those, require canary on 5% traffic and one-week monitoring with rollback auto-threshold.

Risk/mitigation brainstorm (shorthand):
- Risk: regressions hidden in small sample. Mitigation: expand eval set with production-sampled prompts (ask ops to provide sample ids).
- Risk: kernel refactor blocks rollout. Mitigation: small-surface pilot on dedicated pool + rollback policy + feature flag.
- Risk: customer surprise from changed responses. Mitigation: opt-in beta + clear comms + ability to pin model versions per-customer.

Proposed decisions to request at sync:
- Approve July pilot for KV-cache auto-rollout on dedicated for internal beta (owner: Raj).
- Approve expanded eval sampling plan and 2-week canary threshold (owner: Maya + Ops).
- Product to finalize gating thresholds by EOD 2026-06-15 (owner: Olivia).

Follow-ups / action items (working list):
- Olivia: finalize gating thresholds doc and post to Confluence; due 2026-06-15. (linked to confluence:ROADMAP-Q3-2026)
- Maya + Ops: produce production-sampled prompt set (2k samples) and run regression evals on quantized candidate; due 2026-06-21.
- Raj: assess feasibility of temporary compatibility branch for quantized kernels and estimate engineering cost; due 2026-06-18.
- Dylan: adjust autoscaling policy for dedicated quantized pool to avoid double-scheduling; small infra PR; due 2026-06-25.
- Asha: add dashboard panels (per-route cost, quality regression trend) to Redwood Console for pilot; due 2026-06-23.
- All: be prepared to approve pilot start in next sync (2026-06-21).

Notes-to-self / items to ask live in sync:
- Bring specific examples of long-context regressions (1-2 transcripts) for Maya to walk through.
- Ask Raj if kernel refactor timeline has any wiggle room or if we can parallelize backports.
- Confirm SLO for p95 baseline value (need exact number for gating math).

Quick links (placeholders):
- Confluence: ROADMAP-Q3-2026 (TODO link)
- JIRA: ENG-4820 (kernel refactor), ML-1294 (quantization prototype), PROD-3012 (KV-cache rollout)
- GitHub: github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/6142 (experimental quantized support)

Tone/notes: keep sync tight, avoid deep ML explainer in this forum (defer to follow-up deep-dive if team requests), aim for decisions not just status.

Scratch / extra thoughts (untidy):
- Could we run hybrid routing for canary: route 80% to baseline, 20% to quantized variant but with small token budget caps to limit exposure? Might make cost signal noisy.
- If we can show >20% cost savings on short-context workloads, maybe rollout to chat/assistant customers first (less long-form risk).

End of prep notes.
